props.name: labelPlot
props.default: 'Chart data. Use the arrow keys to move between slices, Home and End for the first and last, Escape to leave.'

slots.name: header
slots.description: Content for the header row, replacing the default title block

slots.name: center
slots.description: Centred in the donut hole — a KPI number, a label, an icon

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Replaces the empty-state message when there is no data

slots.name: loading
slots.description: Replaces the built-in spinner while `loading` is set

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Content for the footer row below the plot

cssParts.name: header
cssParts.description: Header row above the plot (hosts the `header` slot)

cssParts.name: canvas
cssParts.description: The plot surface the chart draws into

cssParts.name: empty
cssParts.description: Empty-state overlay, shown when there is no data

cssParts.name: loading
cssParts.description: Loading overlay, shown while `loading` is set

cssParts.name: footer
cssParts.description: Footer row below the plot (hosts the `footer` slot)

cssCustomProps.name: --md-pie-chart-block-size
cssCustomProps.description: Explicit chart height, overriding the aspect ratio (default: auto)

cssCustomProps.name: --md-pie-chart-min-block-size
cssCustomProps.description: Floor the chart height never drops below (density-aware)

cssCustomProps.name: --md-pie-chart-aspect-ratio
cssCustomProps.description: Width:height ratio when no block-size is set (default: 1 / 1, i.e. square)

cssCustomProps.name: --md-pie-chart-padding
cssCustomProps.description: Inset between the host edge and the plot canvas (density-aware)

cssCustomProps.name: --md-pie-chart-shape
cssCustomProps.description: Corner radius of the chart surface (density-aware)

cssCustomProps.name: --md-pie-chart-empty-background
cssCustomProps.description: Empty-state overlay fill (defaults to the chart background)

cssCustomProps.name: --md-pie-chart-empty-icon-size
cssCustomProps.description: Size of an icon slotted into the empty state

cssCustomProps.name: --md-pie-chart-center-color
cssCustomProps.description: Text colour of the donut centre (the `center` slot)
